priorityList: Pre-combat: Summon your pet and use Grimoire of Sacrifice if you have the talent.
Maintain Haunt on your target at all times.
Keep Agony and Corruption active on the target; refresh them when they are within the pandemic window (30% remaining duration).
Cast Dark Harvest if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards and the cast will finish before your dots expire.
Cast Summon Darkglare once Dark Harvest is on cooldown.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities while Summon Darkglare is active or if the fight is ending.
Cast Malefic Grasp if you have 2 or more stacks of Nightfall or if Summon Darkglare is about to expire.
Use Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt if not talented into Drain Soul) when you have 2 or more stacks of Nightfall.
Spend Soul Shards or Shard Instability procs on Unstable Affliction.
If the target will die in less than 8 seconds, prioritize spending any remaining Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction.
Channel Drain Soul (or cast Shadow Bolt) as your filler when no other priority actions are available.
